_comment: data_video1 has NO verified camera geometry. camera.md is absent and the
draft in data_video1.json was never confirmed against tracked trajectories.
This file is the honest uncalibrated state: every geometry collection is
empty and auto_road_fallback is false, so SceneContext.has_geometry and
has_road are both False and all geometry-dependent rules (stopped_vehicle,
wrong_way, solid_line_crossing, red_light, stop_line, jaywalking, turns)
stay inactive. Emitting no events is correct until a human calibrates lanes,
stop lines, crossings, solid lines and signal ROIs from measured tracks.
See data/scene_geometry_status.md for what is verified and what is missing.
